purpose: Persist compact accepted Advanced Search field deltas and a fast current source-owned SR projection without retaining whole workbook rows or letting source data overwrite SOMA-owned relationships/history.

field_registry.identity: SRNo is service_requests.official_sr_no and is not duplicated as a mutable field observation
field_registry.rule: future-use fields have provenance-only authority in Beta 1.0 and cannot drive relationships/SLA/Infrastructure/Inventory/UI workflow unless separately activated by accepted requirement

tables.name: sr_source_field_observations
columns: sr_source_field_observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
field_key TEXT NOT NULL
value_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(value_kind IN ('text','instant','duration_seconds','controlled'))
text_value TEXT
integer_value INTEGER
source_chronology_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_chronology_utc>=0)
source_evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL
accepted_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)

CHECK((value_kind IN ('text','controlled') AND text_value IS NOT NULL AND integer_value IS NULL) OR (value_kind IN ('instant','duration_seconds') AND text_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NOT NULL))
rules: only accepted usable allowlisted values are inserted as field observations
unchanged accepted values are not redundantly appended merely because a newer workbook repeats them
unknown/malformed/blank/missing evidence is represented by staging/review findings and does not insert a replacing usable observation unless field contract explicitly authorizes clearing

source_evidence_id references the accepted import/reconciliation evidence identity supplied by the HLD-05/LLD-03 Advanced Search pipeline; exact table FK is resolved with that pipeline before packet completion

tables.name: sr_current_source_projection
tables.purpose: rebuildable current source-owned values selected field-by-field from newest accepted usable observations
columns: service_request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
problem_summary_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
report_date_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_contact_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_severity_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
current_handler_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
status_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_org_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_account_code_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
suspend_planned_end_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
suspension_duration_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
last_update_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: projection row is derived/rebuildable and owns no unique history
each pointer must reference an observation for the same Service Request and expected field_key; database/application verification enforces this
current field selection uses source chronology and field-specific usability, not whole-row recency
missing/blank/unknown newer evidence never clears a prior recognized value unless explicit field rule permits clearing

status_rules: recognized Closed/Resolved/Cancelled source status may establish terminal current presentation
missing/blank/unknown status cannot erase recognized terminal evidence
terminal-to-nonterminal reversal requires separate high-risk reviewed correction and preserves prior terminal observation
source disappearance is a reviewed warning/evidence state and never deletes/archives/finalizes the SR
privacy_storage: full source workbook rows/copies and unallowlisted fields are not stored as generic SR history; only bounded accepted deltas/provenance required by contract persist.
